test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eight people, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting is a straight line facing south. B is sitting at one of the ends of the line. G is sitting to the immediate left of C. A is sitting to the immediate left of H and immediate right of C. Only 3 people are sitting to the right of E. D is sitting to the immediate left of B. Who is sitting to the immediate left of D?
solution:
Given, eight people, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting is a straight line facing south.

B is sitting at one of the ends of the line.

D is sitting to the immediate left of B.

Only 3 people are sitting to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f5ecc6be4c29cedb787c0eaa96094ede61a876349ae160c484fd190fc34a4cb.png] 

G is sitting to the immediate left of C.

A is sitting to the immediate left of H and immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba0e5cb1cac340ff9cf42909496f5dc76b0af2aa85d85bf8a06d26cf26ca0f81.png] 

And F sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3589e76738443ee4001910f485487991e5237397df2e3702a153cade34db448.png] 

F is sitting to the immediate left of D.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
